notes.title: Emberfall Demo release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After months of hard work on this new concept, I’m thrilled to release the Emberfall demo—just in time for the Steam Next Fest!

🔥 What to expect in the demo:

 Fully compatible and playable on the Steam Deck (use the "scout" launcher option, not Proton).
 Some upgrades are available in the shop to help you start stronger!
 Two exclusive achievements can be unlocked only in the demo!
 20+ different upgrades to experiment with.
 10+ different enemies to fight against.
 One map is available, but there are multiple ways to find your escape!
 Steam Input integration—should work with any controller!
 Steam Cloud support (shared with the full game), so your progress will carry over to the full game.


❤️ Enjoying the demo? Spread the word!

Emberfall is a game I’ve poured my love and passion into, and I truly believe in its unique and fun concept.
I've always developed games with the community in mind, so please share any feedback, suggestions, or bug reports!

You can also join the Discord community server here: https://discord.gg/wRzSsHg

🚀 What’s next?

I plan to launch Emberfall in Early Access so I can continue improving the game with your feedback and ideas!

Here’s what’s in the works:

 different maps
 more monsters, especially those that can shoot at you
 more features to unlock, that let you progress in the map
 new type of attacks, including ranged attacks
 new AOE abilities
 a boss system (haven’t tested it yet, but I think it could work!).
 collectibles and chests to discover
 Co-op mode that you could play with a friend on a special map!


Sounds exciting right?

Have any cool ideas? Let me know!

Until then I tell you ee you soon and GLHF, you need it.
~ Inateno
